a:r.a:t: Urea Cycle and Citric Acid Cycle

p:cNvPr.descr: This image depicts links between the urea cycle and citric acid cycle. In the cytosol and overlapping into the mitochondrial matrix, at the top right is the urea cycle, which is a circle of blue arrows. At the top of this an arrow points to arginine, which has an arrow branching off from it pointing to urea. Arginine is also pointing to ornithine. From ornithine is another arrow pointing to ornithine, which has an arrow pointing to citrulline. This arrow also has an arrow from carbamoyl phosphate merging with it. Citrulline has an arrow pointing to citrulline. From there, an arrow points to argininosuccinate. This completes the urea cycle. In the mitochondrial matrix at the bottom is the citric acid cycle, which is a circle of blue arrows. To the bottom left of this circle, an arrow points to fumarate, which then has an arrow pointing to malate. From there, an arrow points to oxaloacetate. To the left of this, there is a curved arrow from NAD+ to NADH. This completes the citric acid cycle. Above and to the left of the citric acid cycle is a circle of blue arrows, representing malate-aspartate shuttle. Above that, is a half circle, with blue arrows wrapping around above the malate-aspartate shuttle. This half-circle represents aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt of citric acid cycle. From oxaloacetate in the citric acid cycle has an arrow pointing up to aspartate in malate-aspartate shuttle. To the left of this arrow is a curved arrow from glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate. The arrow points up to aspartate, which has an arrow pointing up and arroundaround to oxaloacetate. To the right of this arrow, it has a straight arrow pointing up to argininosuccinate, which then points up and around to fumarate in the aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt of citrictric acid cycle. Oxaloacetate in malate-aspartate shuttle points down and around to malate. To the left of this arrow is a curved arrow from NADH to NAD+. Malate then has an arrow pointing to malate, which then has an arrow pointing to malate in the citric acidc cycle. Fumarate in the aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt of citric acid cycle has an arrow pointing down and around to the first malate in the malate-aspartate shuttle.
